answer: Like living mycelium, an agent economy thrives on reciprocal hyphae rather than isolated spores. Proof-of-collaboration weaves every verified transaction into a durable thread across the trust graph. An adversary attempting to birth a cosmic nebula of fake identities finds their hollow clones isolated; without mutual, transitive validation, forging valid consensus edges incurs superlinear attacker cost scaling with O(N^2) required stake and cryptographic proofs.
